author: Contributor 182
about: Loopline, a two-person Lisbon startup giving podcasters branded show-notes links on a fork of Dub's open-source code (9a30e594), on a Tinybird Classic Workspace, Monday 5 January to Tuesday 30 June 2026 (journeys/customer-life.outline.md). The console's sign-up, Organization, billing details and Developer plan, Classic Workspace and Tokens page; the app's clicks and link metadata through the Events API and its dashboard's Endpoint reads; each Classic CLI act as the requests tinybird-cli 5.22.2 (pip install tinybird-cli on 5 January 2026 installs it: released 23 December 2025) sends for it, less its repeated identical reads; a quarantine recovered and truncated; the admin token taken out of the app, the dub_tinybird_token granted read by a forced push whose regression check replays pipe_stats_rt's requests, and the admin token refreshed; a GDPR erasure across five Data Sources; monthly exports, the Workspace deleted and the plan canceled.

        WHEN se.trigger = '' THEN CASE WHEN se.qr = true THEN 'qr' ELSE 'link' END ELSE se.trigger
